_what: VERBATIM measured Magento /graphql responses for tests/test_magento_gql_e3_hardening.py (UNIT M9 F2, flag ENABLE_MAGENTO_GQL_ADAPTER). Each file is one recorded probe: the HTTP status, the response Content-Type header, the byte count, the latency, and the body. Nothing here is authored - every value is copied out of the E3 probe record.
_measurement: UNIT E3, 2026-08-30. scratchpad m8/E3/{probe_magento_gql.py,results.json,summary.json}. 12 candidate Magento fragrance hosts, one Bahrain residential IP, robots.txt fetched + parsed live for every host (no host disallowed /graphql for UA *), >=2.5s per-host throttle, 12 GraphQL probes against a cap of 15. Guest request, no auth header, curl_cffi impersonate=chrome, Content-Type: application/json. Query: {products(filter:{url_key:{eq:"<KEY>"}}){total_count items{name sku price_range{minimum_price{final_price{value currency} regular_price{value currency}}}}}}. Measured hit-rate 6/12 = 50%.
_body_fields: body_json = the complete JSON body, parsed, verbatim. body_text_head = the first 1500 characters of an HTML body the probe truncated; body_complete records whether the stored text is the whole response. The four HTML/empty records are used ONLY for the status + Content-Type gate, which needs no body.
_not_measured: en-kwt.ajmal.com's CORRECT store-view code. E3 measured only that the store-view header was ABSENT and the response came back AED (the default store) on a Kuwait subdomain. No probe established which Store: value forces the KW store, so no store-view header is pinned for that host and the currency reconciliation is what stops the wrong-currency ship. klinq's 'default' is pinned because it is the value the Shape-B store row already sends and the headerless probe returned BHD.
_total_count_zero: No E3 host returned total_count 0. The mapping-miss class is fixtured by tests/fixtures/magento_gql_b3/no_match_empty_control.json (measured on pacoperfumerias.co.uk for an unmapped url_key, B4 sidedoor_probes.json) and is reused by the F2 tests rather than authored again here.

arenal_com_200_json_hit_eur.json.measured: HTTP 200, application/json, 226 bytes, 761ms. total_count 1, final_price 51.45 EUR, regular_price 105 EUR (on sale). B4 control - reproduced exactly.
arenal_com_200_json_hit_eur.json.quirk: plain slug url_key, PDP path carries no suffix.

druni_es_200_json_hit_eur.json.measured: HTTP 200, application/json, 222 bytes, 757ms. total_count 1, final_price 72.95 EUR, regular_price 125 EUR (on sale).

beautysuccess_fr_200_json_hit_eur.json.measured: HTTP 200, application/json, 253 bytes, 836ms. total_count 1, final_price 59.5 EUR, regular_price 85 EUR (on sale).
beautysuccess_fr_200_json_hit_eur.json.quirk: the url_key is the full slug INCLUDING a numeric tail (0911867205) - a numeric TAIL inside a slug is a legitimate url_key, unlike a wholly-numeric last segment. Pins that the numeric-id rejection must not over-reject.

parfumcenter_nl_200_json_hit_eur.json.measured: HTTP 200, application/json, 248 bytes, 610ms. total_count 1, final_price 27.95 EUR == regular_price (not on sale).
parfumcenter_nl_200_json_hit_eur.json.quirk: PDP path ends .html; the url_key is the segment MINUS .html.

klinq_com_200_json_hit_bhd.json.measured: HTTP 200, application/json, 231 bytes, 744ms. total_count 1, final_price 48.13 BHD, regular_price 53.44 BHD (on sale). No store-view header was sent and the response was still BHD.
klinq_com_200_json_hit_bhd.json.quirk: Gulf/Bahrain; PDP path /en/<key>.html, strip .html. The registry currency for klinq.com is BHD, so the response reconciles and the price ships as the genuine magento_graphql_bhd method. The corpus native price was 47.35 BHD - a store-price drift, not a parse difference.

ajmal_kwt_200_json_aed_default_store_lea.class: full hit - WRONG CURRENCY (default store leaked)
ajmal_kwt_200_json_aed_default_store_lea.measured: HTTP 200, application/json, 234 bytes, 739ms. total_count 1, final_price 105.000001 AED == regular_price. The registry currency for en-kwt.ajmal.com is KWD.
ajmal_kwt_200_json_aed_default_store_lea.quirk: THE GCC MISLABEL CLASS. A Kuwait subdomain answered in AED because no store-view header was sent and the DEFAULT store answered. Converting 105 AED to BHD would ship a number roughly 12x below the real KWD price, correctly labelled, and nothing downstream could tell. The adapter must reconcile the response currency against the registry currency and PEND on a mismatch. Also carries the float artefact 105.000001.

parfum_zentrum_de_400_json_schema_diverg.measured: HTTP 400, application/json, 690 bytes, 495ms. Five GraphQL validation errors: url_key is not defined by ProductsFilterInput; total_count / name / sku / price_range cannot be queried on ProductPublicCollection / ProductPublic ('Did you mean seo?').
parfum_zentrum_de_400_json_schema_diverg.quirk: The endpoint is LIVE and speaks GraphQL - it runs a custom/newer ProductPublic schema with no url_key filter. A 400 is therefore a schema miss, not a transport failure: log it and decline, and never re-issue the same query against the same host.

douglas_at_404_json_framework.json.measured: HTTP 404, application/json; charset=utf-8, 60 bytes, 264ms. Body {"statusCode":404,"error":"Not Found","message":"Not Found"} - a generic framework 404, not a GraphQL envelope.
douglas_at_404_json_framework.json.quirk: PROVES the Content-Type gate is not sufficient on its own: this response IS application/json. The data.products shape gate is what rejects it. Also the numeric-id class - douglas PDP paths are /de/p/<numeric-id>, so the last path segment (3001037119) is a product id, not a url_key.

flaconi_de_404_html_spa_catchall.json.measured: HTTP 404, text/html; charset=UTF-8, 2,084,007 bytes, 2143ms. The SPA catch-all page - /graphql is not a GraphQL route. Stored body is the first 1500 characters only (body_complete false); the gate needs status + Content-Type, not the body.
flaconi_de_404_html_spa_catchall.json.quirk: 2MB of HTML billed as a GraphQL answer. platform=magento was true for this host and the endpoint still does not exist.

breuninger_com_404_html_oups.json.measured: HTTP 404, text/html;charset=UTF-8, 663,202 bytes, 1595ms. The 'Oups | Breuninger Online Shop' SPA error page. Stored body is the first 1500 characters only.
breuninger_com_404_html_oups.json.quirk: Note the Content-Type has NO space after the semicolon - the gate must split on ';' rather than match a literal string. Also the second numeric-id class: breuninger PDP paths are /de/marken/<brand>/<slug>/<id>/p/, so the last segment is the route marker 'p' and the segment before it is a numeric id - neither is a url_key.

notino_de_403_html_cloudflare.json.measured: HTTP 403, text/html; charset=UTF-8, 6,214 bytes, 39ms. The Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial - served on robots.txt AND on /graphql. curl_cffi impersonate=chrome was not sufficient. Stored body is the first 1500 characters only.
notino_de_403_html_cloudflare.json.quirk: Distinct from a missing endpoint: the host may well run Magento GraphQL behind the wall. Logged as walled so a retry-with-render decision stays possible, and declined all the same.

dm_de_405_empty_no_ctype.json.measured: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed, EMPTY Content-Type, 0 bytes, 390ms.
dm_de_405_empty_no_ctype.json.quirk: The /graphql route exists but rejects POST - it is not Magento GraphQL. An empty Content-Type must not be treated as JSON.
